description: Full-stack project with frontend UI and backend API

shall: All components must have TypeScript type definitions for Props
Use Composition API (Vue) or Hooks (React) for new components
All public APIs must have explicit type annotations
Input validation must use a schema library (zod/joi/class-validator)
All async operations must handle errors with try/catch
API contracts must be shared between frontend and backend
Tests must cover both frontend components and backend endpoints
shall_not: Do not directly manipulate the DOM outside of framework APIs
Do not use any type without documented reason
Do not skip tests with .skip without documented reason
Do not expose internal stack traces to clients
Do not bypass schema validation for any user input
